### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **175** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a73edb3cd784e212c7b8b21757a44c0cfed9adfe` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f9f4a53cc4085d486d0085ecc83f3aa965090b3c` — the merge of head `f1d2ae130cb3b71ffb7273ef52e2da3f06700a51` into base `a73edb3cd784e212c7b8b21757a44c0cfed9adfe`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f9f4a53cc4085d486d0085ecc83f3aa965090b3c && git checkout f9f4a53cc4085d486d0085ecc83f3aa965090b3c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a73edb3cd784e212c7b8b21757a44c0cfed9adfe f1d2ae130cb3b71ffb7273ef52e2da3f06700a51 && git checkout -B drift-repro a73edb3cd784e212c7b8b21757a44c0cfed9adfe && git merge --no-ff f1d2ae130cb3b71ffb7273ef52e2da3f06700a51

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a73edb3cd784e212c7b8b21757a44c0cfed9adfe
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f1d2ae130cb3b71ffb7273ef52e2da3f06700a51`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md, skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, packages/core/src/security/superuser-field-vote-33828.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/fls-own-field-mask-33828.test.ts
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

Reviewed 2026-11-24T16:24Z. Inputs: card #36053 with every comment, the parent ruling on #34365 (record 6912661484), the PR body, the net diff of the head against its merge base `57445a6998`, and the check-runs on the head. Faces: governed rules text (`skills/**`) and published schema (`packages/spec/src/**`). The cited code was read in the tree of the head; nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No accept-set change.** `permission.zod.ts` changes comment lines only, in two docblocks. No schema, no `.describe()` string and no export moves, so no generated artifact moves. Right.
- **The `viewAllFields` docblock, "on an object entry that carries either bit (the set's own entry for the object, else its `'*'` entry) this key changes nothing".** Right. `holdsViewAllFields` and `holdsSuperuserBypass` take the same lookup (`objects[objectName] || objects['*']`), and `superuserFieldVote` reads both under the same own-row exception, so on one entry the bit duplicates the vote. The earlier "on a set" was wrong for a set whose named entry and wildcard differ.
- **The `FieldPermissionSchema` docblock names `viewAllFields` as a voter.** Right against `superuserFieldVote`: a read vote, the same own-`readable: false` exception as View All, never an edit vote.
- **Published skill surface.** `rules/security.md` gains one section and rewrites two paragraphs; the eval file gains ids 36 and 37 (37 cases, no duplicate id). No `SKILL.md` moves.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/skills` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch. Right: the skill change is teaching text, and spec ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so a docblock edit is a published byte with no API change. `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` change test files only and ship `dist`, so neither needs a line. `Clause-②: no` holds: nothing a consumer could author or read is taken away or added. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev open question (body form: closing keyword on line 1, signed trailer last).** Answered by the seat: option A, accepted as the relay convention.
- **The ceiling raise, 4068 to 4292 at headroom 0, on the standing-ruling path.** The path applies. The ratchet header asks three things of a raise with no per-card ruling. (1) Deletion of restatement in the same file: the diff removes the "Locks, never grants" bullet and the recipe URL of the `when` section, 274 bytes; the choice rule above still says the other sets keep their grant, the new section states the union rule, and the docs anchor the same bullet keeps links the recipe (`field-level-security.mdx` line 188). (2) The ruling quoted in the PR body: record 6513306068 and the words 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 are both there. (3) The row moved by the measured remainder and pinned at the measurement: the head blob is 17168 bytes, `ceil(17168 / 4)` is 4292, the merge base and `origin/main` are both 16272 bytes (4068). The added text is ordered by a ruling of record (6912661484, step 2), so the "no growth for a small feature" principle is not in play.
- **Three gate families the dev did not measure** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:type-check-debt`): left to the head's check-runs, which the seat record reads.
- **Branch 11 commits behind `main`.** None of them touches a file of this diff (read with `git diff --name-only` over the range). Draft #36158 moves the same ceiling row; whichever lands second recomputes it.
- **SQL push-down.** No query code in the diff. No finding.
- **Author.** The PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ④ Design judgment

Each taught sentence was read against the code at the head.

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`:

- Three axes, and "from v19 they open no field". Matches the ruled model on #34365 ("The model", staged step 3). Today View All and Modify All still vote; the skill says "from v19", as the card asks.
- "Fields are visible by default … the most permissive answer wins". Matches `getFieldPermissions`: only declaring entries vote, a field no set names is absent from the mask, and votes union.
- `viewAllFields`: a read vote on every field and never an edit vote; the set's own `readable: false` row beats it; no object access and no record. Matches `superuserFieldVote` and `holdsViewAllFields`, which `superuserBypassSets` does not read.
- "On `'*'` it also votes on the fields of private-posture objects, which a plain `'*'` does not grant". Matches: `materializePlainWildcardCoverage` skips a private object, and `holdsViewAllFields` takes no posture. Both merges are pinned in this diff, each with a control that fails without the bit.
- "Studio's matrix keeps the key, has no control for it". Matches: no source file under `ui/` names the key, and `permission-slice.ts` carries unmodelled keys through save.
- `requiredPermissions`: stripped on read and denied on write unless all capabilities are held, strictest-wins over field rows, `viewAllFields`, View All and Modify All. Matches `foldFieldRequiredPermissions`, which overwrites the merged entry after every vote. "With `maskingRule` … reads the partial value" matches `computePartialMaskRules`. `'id_card'` is a preset in `FIELD_MASKING_PRESETS`.

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`:

- Id 36 holds: the auditor set's vote reads `collected_total` over the other set's `readable: false` row, and the bit gives no record and no edit.
- Id 37 holds: the capabilities are granted in `systemPermissions`, which also declares them for `capability-reference-unknown`; Modify All does not re-open either field.
- Both cases exercise what the card's acceptance names.

`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`: both sentences hold, as in ①.

Implementing files: the ratchet row and its comment agree with the measured file. The two pins assert the taught sentence on both merges and on the object axis.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Nits, none of which affects correctness or the contract:

- N1. The file no longer says in words that a `when` entry is absent on the rows it does not match. The section title and the choice rule carry it, and the linked docs section states it.
- N2. Eval 37's expected output says View All or Modify All re-opens a field row, with no "until v19". It is true on this head. The v19 conversion card should revisit that sentence with the skill.
- N3. `maskingRule` is taught only beside `requiredPermissions`. Two facts in the spec docblock are not in the skill: the rule alone masks the field for every non-system caller, and a caller whose merged field row is `readable: false` gets the key deleted, not masked. Neither is in this card's scope.
